title: Cool red netherite sword
description: Replaces the default Netherite Sword with a red version.
body:
Give your Netherite Sword a new look!

This resource pack replaces the default Netherite Sword with a vibrant red version, keeping the original Minecraft aesthetic while making your weapon stand out.

Features:

"❤️ Red Netherite Sword texture"

"🎨 Vanilla-style pixel art"

"⚔️ Great for PvP"

"📦 Lightweight resource pack"
